about: Opt-in perf budget (pnpm --filter @draftroom/e2e perf). Re-baselined 2026-10-03 (G11 HEAVY-PERF) on Lobby's board page: the heavy board (20 frames, 4,500 notes with labels, 200 uploaded images, ALL LOADED: each carries its upload's customData.lobby.file since W5-34), three runs in a quiet window on this PC (AMD Ryzen Threadripper 9970X 32 cores / 64 threads, RTX 5090, Windows 11 Pro 26200, branded Chrome 154 in new headless mode with the GPU flags), harness f4ceabd2 on the app code of release/held 99ac6c52. Each value sits near the slowest of the three runs; a result fails only beyond the margin. latencyVisibleP95Ms: edit in one tab painted in another (p95 of 240 edits, moves and recolours; no other load): 100% measured 190-198 ms; at Lobby's whole-board fit (zoom 0.0455) 203, 237 and 499 ms (the observer tab's long tasks varied 9-92 per run), so the fit budget only guards against gross regressions. editingTabMinFps: frames the editing tab renders while it edits. panMedianFps: median of 3 pans of 600 px at fit, 0.25 and 100% (frame 0's note grid, no image in view); 'fit@60' is the gentle 60 px pan at fit. A miss while the whole machine is busier than maxMachineBusyPct is reported as inconclusive (exit 2). The product gates (§8.5: p95 <= 250 ms at 100%; >= 24 fps at fit, >= 30 at 0.25 and 100%) are printed separately by run.ts.
